correctness.rationale: All three rational cell identities follow from signed λ_i expansions. The derivative numerator P_L(q)=LC−2Cq−(L+b)q² decreases strictly, giving exactly one outer-cell maximizer; comparison of L gives the longer-gap winner. Scaling the minimum gap to one yields C≥2(L+1), then increasing H_L and solving q²+4q−2μ=0 yields the stated exact universal sharp constant. Every equality condition is tracked, and sqrt asymptotics follow from the closed form. Executed 7579 supplementary checks; finite testing is not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The sharp extremal factor and equality meshes resolve the first nontrivial degree-one FH summation sensitivity, replacing a generic quadratic mesh-ratio upper bound with an attained square-root law. Identifying unavoidable cancellation at minimal node count informs algorithm and grid choice, but does not equate conditioning with error for every implementation.
